title: Figure 1: Air Force X-25LR Laser Lightcraft depicted in flight over desert
description: Color concept image of an acorn-shaped, gold-colored craft hovering above a desert landscape with a bright white plasma glow beneath it and a halo-like ring. Caption: "Figure 1. Air Force X-25LR Laser Lightcraft (courtesy of F. Mead, AFRL/PRSP, Edwards AFB, CA)." The text describes the two-mode laser propulsion concept, with a parabolic afterbody mirror focusing ground-based pulsed laser energy into an annular shroud.
